design.reader: New src/lib/multiplayer/server/history/matchJournalBranchSegmentReader.ts: matchJournalBranchSegmentReader(journal: IEventJournal<IMatchJournalEnvelope>) pages journal.readStream over (fromRevision, throughRevision] with branchId = the segment's own id (any branch), and maps each stored event to an IProjectableBranchEvent carrying the stored eventId, branchId, streamRevision, eventVersion, previousStreamEventDigest, eventDigest, entityRefs and eventType, with payload = payload.matchEvent; a stored event whose envelope holds no game event is refused as branch-integrity.
